parse.wikitext:
==Another Night at the Theatre==
{{Checklist|
* Complete the dialogue at Burgh de Rott after the cutscene.
* Teleport to Ver Sinhaza using Drakan's medallion.
* Gear up for a wave based encounter against waves of nylocas, [[the Maiden of Sugadinti]], and the [[Nylocas Vasilias]]. It is recommended to bring your strongest melee weapon, as well as fast weapons for each style for ease of completion.
* The rooms are significantly easier than during [[A Night at the Theatre]], so full gear swaps are not necessary, but can be helpful when fighting the Nylocas Vasilias.
* Talk to Sugadinti just outside the notice board to begin the encounter.
** Wave 1 - Nylocas (range, melee, and mage)
** Wave 2 - [[The Maiden of Sugadinti]]
** Wave 3 - Repeat of wave 1
** Wave 4 - [[Nylocas Vasilias]]
}}
